newsitem.title: UK: Vanguard Medica gains on early trial results.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard Medica gains on early trial results.

text.p: Shares in Vanguard Medica Group Plc jumped on Friday as the fledgling pharmaceutical group said it had received results of clinical trials of its anti-migraine drug VML 251 ahead of schedule.
The stock was up 22-1/2p at 487-1/2 by 1453 GMT in thin trading of 62,435 shares.
The company said results of the phase IIb studies were being analysts and a further announcement would be made in due course.
Vanguard floated on the stock exchange in May but since then its shares have yet to regain the 640p peak hit on the first day of trading.
